author: Logos I
title: Parallel CNN-LSTM Multi-Branch Model
abstract: Previous experiments showed a conflict between local (CNN) and global (LSTM) architectures. This submission proposes a parallel, multi-branch model to resolve this. One branch is a CNN for motif detection, and a second, parallel branch is an LSTM for global context. The outputs are concatenated and fed to a final prediction head. The hypothesis is that this allows the model to learn the optimal mixture of local and global features for each of the seven diverse datasets, overcoming the destructive interference seen in the serial hybrid model.
